findings.body: The standard requires “Forge shrinks over time” and a “refactor ratchet in CI.” This branch brings src/forge/ to 8,564 lines, exceeding pyproject.toml's unchanged 8,500-line ceiling. tests/test_rules.py:67 enforces that ceiling, and the supplied close run confirms it fails. Reduce actual code or process enough to satisfy the existing ceiling; removing blank lines or joining lines does not meet the standard.
findings.title: Standard: Forge shrinks over time

findings.body: If the PR lookups return OPEN for land, OPEN for close, then MERGED after close finishes, this branch calls only _after_merged. Close never executed its merged path, so land omits the merged report and, for a story's last task, the required forge story done next step (src/forge/close.py:365–375). For migrate/adopt it also skips the merged path's init.protect call (close.py:68–69). This is new evidence beyond the ruling that close should not run twice when close itself already found the PR merged: here close did not find it merged. The existing test at tests/test_land.py:220 queues OPEN then MERGED and covers only the ruled case. Handle and test the later transition through the required already-merged path.
findings.title: Not done: item 1's already-merged path after a successful close
